Alice M.: Heads-up: Keystone hotfix (PR #1347) slated for 2026-03-18 20:00 UTC. We need 2x LGTM before 19:30 UTC to proceed. If not, we'll postpone to next maintenance window. Details: https://github.com/redwood/keystone/pull/1347
release-bot: Deploy job queued. Cutoff reminder at 19:30 UTC. CI: green ✅
Bob S.: Looking now — smoke locally passing. Leaving one nit in PR, but not blocking. Can give LGTM after fix.
Carol T.: @Bob S. any ETA on that nit? If it's small we can squash + merge and mark as hotfix.
Bob S.: ETA ~10m. it's a typed var name in tests. I'll push a commit.
Dave L.: I'm +1 on behavior/regression check, ran a quick canary against staging, looks fine. Will give LGTM when test commit lands.
Bob S.: Pushed fix, CI re-run: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/9876
Dave L.: LGTM :thumbsup:
Alice M.: Thanks — need one more. @Carol T. can you eyeball the change? it's small.
Carol T.: On it, checking now... small nit doesn't affect runtime. LGTM from me.
Alice M.: :tada: 2x LGTM achieved before cutoff. release-bot please proceed with deploy-canary -> full.
release-bot: Starting canary deployment (keystone-hotfix-1347) to canary pool. Monitor channel: #incidents. Auto rollback at +5min if error rate > 0.5%.
Bob S.: Watching logs. I see one 500 around canary node, investigating.
Dave L.: Noticing increased 429s on canary, looks like a retry storm — rolling back makes sense if it persists.
Alice M.: If rollback, we'll open a quick postmortem but priority is stability. Keep me pinged.
